detail.longDescription: 25 popular projects, 250 external base-image refs. Only 7.6% (19) pin to an immutable sha256 digest. 81.6% ride a mutable version tag; 10.8% are :latest or untagged. The same projects SHA-pin their GitHub Actions 67.6% of the time. Same supply-chain idea, a fraction of the adoption. # supplychain # docker # devsecops https:// zennoxa.com/research/base-imag e-pinning-2026
